entries.title: Batched pull requests no longer use a queue inside your project
entries.body: Infinitary no longer sets up or reads a queue inside a project. Every project set to batched pull requests now merges your approved changes together as one batch pull request, including a project that still carries the old queue's files. Settings → Projects no longer shows the queue's key, its paused batch or its setup steps. If a project still carries those files, your first mate offers once to have a crewmate remove them with a pull request, and tells you when a rule on the main branch still asks for the old queue's check.
entries.noPicture: The change removes panels that showed only for a project carrying the old queue's files; what remains is the Projects tab as every other batched project already showed it.

entries.title: Update Infinitary on the computers that run work for you
entries.body: This version changes how your computers work together. A computer that runs work for you takes no new work until it runs this version too, and you can update it from Devices. A computer or phone that shows your first mate keeps working as before.
entries.noPicture: This changes which versions of Infinitary work together, not the layout or words of a screen.
